text:
Asha (PM): FYI: planning to cut SDK v4.2 tomorrow morning. Key changes: Windows arm64 wheels, default retry/backoff now uses jittered exponential, and docs snippets will move to structured JSON snippet objects. also we'll flip the sync-client default in ~6 months (migration guide is in flight).

Leo (Engine): the retry change is not an API surface break, just a defaults change. heavy clients should test — opt-out env var: `REDWOOD_RETRY_MODE=legacy`.

Priya (Docs): drafting the migration doc now. new snippet format we want is: `{"type":"snippet","lang":"js","source":"..."}` so the site can render variants and embed runnable sandboxes. will include before/after examples for py/js/go and a curl example.

Tom (DevEx): please include a short note for sample-app maintainers: wheels available behind a feature-flag for the first 72h while we monitor crash reports. office hours scheduled for next Tue.

Asha (PM): schedule + comms plan please: changelog entry, help-center article, migration checklist, and a short customer email cadence (90/30/7 days) before the default flip.

Priya (Docs): changelog PR opened: https://git.internal/r/redwood/docs/pulls/318. added FAQ about arm64 perf and cost. removing inline ad-hoc snippets from guides in favor of the schema to improve copy/citation.

Leo (Engine): small CI note: added a compatibility test that toggles `REDWOOD_RETRY_MODE` and runs the sample load-gen. packaging job kicked off for win-arm64.

release-bot: Release candidate 4.2.0-rc1 created by Leo. Logs: https://ci.internal/jobs/4958

Asha (PM): good work. Priya, Tom — coordinate on the docs + release checklist, please. I'll post a short all-hands blurb after the cut. :rocket:

Priya (Docs): will do, landing PRs and updating the snippets canonicalizer by EOD.
